_comment: Per-series cadence/publish-lag overrides for heartbeat.classify. Keys are exact series_id or a 'prefix.*' glob. cadence_days forces the cadence; publish_lag_days is subtracted from elapsed so a feed's inherent publish lag isn't read as overdue. Keeps STALE/DEAD meaningful (a feed past lag+2x cadence still trips).
_fx_comment: FRED H.10 daily-FX rates publish in weekly batches ~1wk late (verified vs FRED's own keyless CSV 2026-08-03: latest obs was 07-24, our DB matched exactly). The generic fred.* 3-day lag is too short; these get 7. Still trips STALE on a real multi-week break.
_gas_comment: GASREGW is WEEKLY retail gasoline; the fred.* glob wrongly forced it to daily cadence, so a normal 7-day gap read STALE. Restore weekly cadence.
